title_en: I have been in China for three years
summary_en: I came to China to study and work for three years. Five years ago, I first visited China and fell in love with the food here. After I returned to China, I started learning Chinese online. I started learning by myself and then found a Chinese teacher online to help me. After I passed the A-level exam, I wanted to come to China to continue my studies. After arriving in China, I first studied Chinese in Beijing and then found a job in Shanghai. I have lived in Shanghai for three years. I have learned more and more about Chinese culture and made many Chinese friends. I want to go there next year...
